properties.title: Motor Yacht Bliss, Miami, FL
properties.content:
USCG Miami contacted NOAA this afternoon about the Motor Yacht Bliss, reported to have caught on fire and then sunk at about 1000 this morning. The vessel was said to be carrying about 600gal of diesel fuel. The location was given as 25°49'N--80°03'W: about 4 miles off Miami Beach, Florida.

It is unknown if there is any product in the water at the moment, but an overflight is underway.  The search and rescue is complete, and the Coast Guard has requested a trajectory analysis for any possible released fuel.
